instruction.name: vmaddwev.q.d
instruction.description: Multiply the even-positioned signed 64-bit elements in `b` and the corresponding signed 64-bit elements in `c`, extending both to 128-bit, and add the product to the 128-bit elements in `a`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 6.99; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vmaddwev.q.d $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vmaddwev.q.d $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vmaddwev.q.d $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vmaddwev.q.d $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vmaddwev.q.d $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vmaddwev.q.d $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vmaddwev.q.d $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vmaddwev.q.d $vr7, $vr15, $vr23

throughput.notes: 8 independent lanes retire in about 7 cycles (7.11 measured), so the sustained rate is 8/7 = 1.14 IPC (CPI 7/8 = 0.875). Recorded as the exact fraction rather than an integer, since 8 lanes cannot complete in 7 cycles at an integer CPI. Measured with the slope method.
